name: Formation Evaluation
description: One row per evaluation criterion, so the criteria set is data. A request cannot be approved while any criterion is unassessed.

fields.label: Criterion
fields.options:
Gap In Coverage
Duplication
Escalation Pathway
Framework Alignment
Resource Feasibility

fields.label: Assessment
fields.description: A finding, not a workflow state. The approval gate asks whether every criterion has a finding.

fields.label: Comments
fields.description: Required once the criterion has a finding.
